description: N50 secondary permanent holdout, cycle 2026Q2. Per docs/superpowers/specs/2026-04-22-n50-secondary-holdout-design.md. Never-touch for weight tuning, routing, or meta-learner feedback. One-time measurement per release cycle, then retired. Seed batch only — curation continues in subsequent sessions toward n_target=50.
bsa_rationale: ICRP Reference Man (70 kg × 1.74 m) BSA. Spec §9 Open Questions #1 resolved to 1.85. Used for all mg/m² → mg conversions in this file.
methodology_notes: Observed Cmax reported as mean ± SD when primary source uses arithmetic statistics; as geometric mean with 90% CI in notes when that is the primary-source convention. SD field is null for geometric-mean-only sources. 2026-04-22 seed expansion (commit pending): added paclitaxel, docetaxel, micafungin, benzylpenicillin, torsemide (5 OATP1B1 substrates). benzylpenicillin classified as iv_infusion duration 4 min (rather than iv_bolus) because the FDA label's 3-5 min push is physically a short zero-order input; V3.1 infusion path handles it correctly and matches the Cmax timing (400 mg/L at 5-6 min post-start). 2026-04-22 second expansion: added vimseltinib, nerandomilast, balcinrenone, tolebrutinib, zibotentan (5 non-OATP1B1 oral drugs). Cmax in nmol/L converted to mg/L using MW from PubChem: nerandomilast MW=449.0 g/mol (710 nmol/L x 449.0/1000 = 0.3188 mg/L); balcinrenone MW=399.4 g/mol (4602 nmol/L x 399.4/1000 = 1.838 mg/L). 2026-04-23 third expansion: added sulopenem, ensitrelvir, elafibranor, obicetrapib, mirdametinib (5 non-OATP1B1 oral drugs, mechanism-diverse: penem antibiotic + OAT3 substrate, oral 3CL antiviral, dual PPAR agonist, CETP inhibitor, MEK1/2 inhibitor). All Cmax values cross-validated against DailyMed (FDA labels) or PMC primary papers. Sulopenem/ensitrelvir doses reported as labeled-salt mass; Cmax is for active species. Mirdametinib dose 4 mg maps to BSA 1.85 m² via GOMEKLI Table 1 (≥1.50 m² band), Cmax is steady-state per label Table 6.

irinotecan.notes: Nozawa et al 2005 DMD 33:434 established OATP1B1 substrate role. Cmax reported here is for parent irinotecan only (not SN-38 active metabolite). SN-38 is formed by intracellular CES1/2 hydrolysis and is the pharmacologically active species, but clinical Cmax of SN-38 is 0.0263 mg/L — not what our engine would try to predict from a dose of irinotecan. Per spec §A1, we evaluate parent Cmax only. Prodrug-to-metabolite dynamics are a DDI/metabolism question explicitly out of scope.

paclitaxel.notes: OATP1B3 (primary) + OATP1B1 (secondary) substrate per Smith NF et al 2005 Chem Biol Interact 152:287–298; established in Leblanc et al 2018 DMD review as well. Paclitaxel is solubilized in Cremophor EL, which itself perturbs PK nonlinearly; the FDA label Cmax reflects the clinically administered Cremophor-containing product (i.e., Taxol, not nab-paclitaxel Abraxane). Mean Cmax 3650 ng/mL = 3.65 mg/L. SD not provided by the label — arithmetic mean only, consistent with rifampin entry precedent. Cross-study interstudy median from Vion 2023 systematic review (PMC8572663) Table 1 is 5.1 μM (= 4.35 mg/L at MW 853.9) [IQR 4.5–5.7 μM = 3.84–4.87 mg/L] across n=18 studies, reassuringly close to label value. Nonlinear PK: Cmax increases supra-proportionally with dose (Gianni 1995 JCO 13:180–190). AAFE-interpretation caveat: engine Cmax prediction may over/under estimate depending on whether nonlinear saturation is modeled.

docetaxel.dose_conversion_note: 100 mg/m² × BSA 1.85 m² = 185 mg. Used 100 mg/m² (not 75 mg/m²) because Baker 2004 reports Cmax mean ± SD at this dose; 75 mg/m² is reported in the same paper only as later-timepoint concentrations. 100 mg/m² is an FDA-approved dose for breast and NSCLC indications.

docetaxel.notes: OATP1B3 (primary) + OATP1B1 (secondary) substrate per Smith NF et al 2005 Chem Biol Interact 152:287–298 and de Graan et al 2012 Clin Cancer Res 18:4433–4440. micafungin.notes: OATP1B1 substrate role established by Sandhu et al 2005 Antimicrob Agents Chemother 49:2602–2609 (alongside caspofungin, already admitted to N50). Large cyclic lipopeptide MW 1270 — will trigger AD flag for molecular weight, analogous to caspofungin. Cmax reported as geometric mean (SD in parentheses per the paper's Table 2 legend). Cross-check: Hebert 2005 J Clin Pharmacol 45:1145–1152 (in the same weighted-average pool) gave Cmax 8.8 mg/L with CV 20% at n=26 healthy volunteers; Chandrasekar & Sobel 2006 CID Table 1 aggregates to 9.1 mg/L weighted across Hebert and other registered healthy-volunteer studies. Value used here (10.3) is the Undre 2014 primary paper's directly tabulated 100 mg Cmax in matched healthy controls.

benzylpenicillin.dose_original: 5 million units (5 MU) penicillin G potassium
benzylpenicillin.dose_conversion_note: 1 MU penicillin G potassium ≈ 600 mg (USP conversion 1595 units/mg for potassium salt, but clinical rule-of-thumb 1 MU = 600 mg is standard for penicillin G potassium per Drugs.com/AHFS). 5 MU × 600 mg/MU = 3000 mg. Alternative exact conversion (1595 U/mg) gives 5e6 / 1595 ≈ 3134 mg; 3000 mg chosen as the rounded clinical equivalent used in prescribing literature.

benzylpenicillin.notes: OATP1B1 substrate evidence from Hirano M et al 2006 Drug Metab Dispos 34:1229–1236 (penicillin G is a weak OATP1B1 substrate, in contrast to its stronger OAT3/MRP2 substrate roles). Renal clearance dominates disposition (~80% unchanged in urine via tubular secretion). Cmax reported here is the arithmetic mean from a 10-patient study, documented without SD in the FDA label narrative — consistent with rifampin entry precedent (label source, mean only). Bolus duration 3–5 min → 4 min midpoint used; route classified `iv_bolus` because the FDA label uses 'bolus' language. Measurement at 5–6 min post-end-of-bolus is effectively Cmax (slight distribution-phase attenuation may mean true Cmax is higher, but per spec A1 we report the observed clinical Cmax).

torsemide.notes: OATP1B1 substrate evidence from Werner U et al 2008 Pharmacogenet Genomics 18:357-366 and Vormfelde SV et al 2008 J Pharmacol Exp Ther (SLCO1B1 521T>C reduces torsemide clearance in humans, confirming hepatic OATP1B1 uptake contributes to disposition). Arithmetic mean +/- SD reported by Khan 2008 for the reference (marketed Cipla Dytor) formulation; test formulation (Macleods) gave 3399 +/- 582 ng/mL -- bioequivalent. Demadex FDA label (accessdata.fda.gov/label/2017/020136s027lbl.pdf) confirms qualitative PK (Cmax within 1 h, F approx 80%, half-life ~3.5 h) but does not tabulate a numeric Cmax at the 20 mg dose, hence use of the Khan 2008 primary paper. Caveat: single-study N=12 healthy males from an Indian bioequivalence trial -- smaller/more-homogeneous than ideal; CV of 13.5% is consistent with a tightly selected bioequivalence cohort. An alternative higher-quality source (Brater 1987 Clin Pharmacol Ther) exists but is paywalled and not verifiable through open channels in this session.

nerandomilast.notes: FDA NME approved January 2025 (Jascayd) for IPF and PPF. PDE4B preferential inhibitor. n=6 is at the minimum threshold; the phase I trial total enrolled 42 subjects (randomised 36 mg, 48 mg SAD + 6 mg, 12 mg MAD); each SAD cohort had n=6 healthy males. Geometric mean Cmax 710 nmol/L with gCV 20.7% at 36 mg (the lower of two single-dose cohorts; 48 mg gave 955 nmol/L, gCV 15.5%). Chose 36 mg as it is closer to the approved therapeutic dose range. OATP1B1 substrate status not explicitly stated in the PMC paper; classified false based on absence from known OATP1B1 substrate tables and PDE inhibitor class characteristics. zibotentan.notes: AstraZeneca endothelin A receptor antagonist (ZD4054). Originally developed for prostate cancer (Phase III failure 2012); revived by AZ for CKD and diabetic nephropathy (Phase II ongoing 2024-2026). Included as non-NME drug with 2024 primary HV PK publication. Healthy matched controls in the renal/hepatic impairment study constitute the healthy volunteer reference group (standard PK study design). No OATP1B1 substrate data found in any published source; classified false. Predominantly renally eliminated (~58% unchanged in urine); CYP3A4 is the major metabolic pathway per earlier xenobiotic studies (Xenobiotica 2011). Geometric mean Cmax 261.3 ng/mL = 0.261 mg/L at 5 mg oral dose. The earlier hepatic/renal impairment study (PMC3070638) also provides healthy control Cmax of ~550 ng/mL at 10 mg -- consistent with dose-proportional PK. Used 2024 paper as the primary source as it is more recent. Exclusion check: grep -iwx 'zibotentan' /tmp/n50_exclusion.txt returned no match.

sulopenem.dose_conversion_note: Dose reported as 500 mg prodrug (sulopenem etzadroxil) per FDA label; active species is sulopenem (rapidly hydrolyzed pre-systemically). Cmax measured on active sulopenem. Probenecid co-administration boosts Cmax via OAT3 inhibition at renal tubule; engine must treat this as DDI or will underpredict.

sulopenem.notes: FDA NME approved 25 Oct 2024 for uncomplicated UTI (Orlynvah); first oral penem in ~30 years and first oral probenecid-boosted beta-lactam. Label explicitly states sulopenem is an OAT3 substrate + does not inhibit OATP1B1/B3 -- confirms zero overlap with the 8 OATP1B1 substrates in the N50 seed. Renal elimination 40.8% (3.1% unchanged) + fecal 44.3% (26.9% unchanged). SD not tabulated in label; observed_cmax_sd_mg_l=null with CV recorded. SMILES + CID + formula + MW cross-validated against PubChem (InChIKey match including stereochemistry). URL verified at DailyMed 2026-04-23 (HTTP 200). ensitrelvir.dose_original: Ensitrelvir fumaric acid 250 mg (salt form); marketed in Japan as Xocova.
ensitrelvir.dose_conversion_note: Primary paper (Shimizu 2022) reports doses as ensitrelvir fumaric acid. 250 mg fumaric acid = approx 212 mg ensitrelvir free base (MW ratio 0.848), but dose/Cmax pair is reported in salt-mass convention; using 250 mg to match primary source. Single-dose 250 mg sits within dose-linear range (20-2000 mg SAD) and avoids steady-state CYP3A autoinhibition that complicates therapeutic-dose Cmax prediction.

elafibranor.notes: FDA NME approved 10 Jun 2024 (accelerated approval) for primary biliary cholangitis. First-in-class dual PPAR-alpha/delta agonist approved for PBC. Steady-state Cmax from ELATIVE Phase 3 (NCT04526665) 80 mg QD Day 15 in PBC patients (N=108 active arm; sub-N for PK analysis not separately tabulated but CV 55% is consistent with popPK estimate from the full cohort). Patient cohort (not HV) -- acceptable per spec with condition flagged. Label explicitly states NOT an OATP1B1 substrate -- confirmed via DailyMed. Metabolized by CYP2J2 + UGT1A3/1A4/2B7 (rare UGT enzyme coverage in the N50 set). Active metabolite GFT1007 has 3.2x parent AUC but spec A1 evaluates parent Cmax only. SMILES + CID + formula + MW cross-validated against PubChem (InChIKey match with E-stereochemistry). URL verified 2026-04-23 (HTTP 200). Exclusion grep clean.

obicetrapib.notes: Obicetrapib (TA-8995, DEZ-001) 4th-generation CETP inhibitor in pivotal Phase 3. Not yet FDA-approved but meets spec via 2024 open-access primary PK paper (Wiley CC-BY-4.0, Nicholls 2024 Pharmacol Res Perspect). SD derived from geometric CV: 251 x 0.23 = 57.7 ng/mL = 0.0577 mg/L (note: arithmetic SD and geometric CV are strictly not identical but at CV 23% the approximation error is <5%). Clearance profile is orthogonal to everything else in the N50 seed: per companion Lepor 2025 DDI paper, obicetrapib is 'not extensively metabolized' with 63.8% fecal (mostly unchanged) + 15.4% urinary -- tests the engine's low-extraction / biliary-efflux path. Lepor 2025 also states obicetrapib is 'not a substrate of either efflux or uptake transporters' -- classified oatp1b1_substrate=false on that basis. Half-life 124 h is the longest in the N50 seed. MW 722 triggers engine AD flag; acceptable per spec. N=6 at minimum threshold; HV fasted. SMILES + CID + formula + MW cross-validated against PubChem (InChIKey match with S,S-stereochemistry). URL verified 2026-04-23 (HTTP 200). Exclusion grep clean.

mirdametinib.dose_original: 2 mg/m² BID (capsule banded by BSA). For adult BSA ≥1.50 m² (Sisyphus BSA 1.85 m² band): 4 mg BID. Band-dose not linear mg/m².
mirdametinib.dose_conversion_note: Sisyphus BSA 1.85 m² -> GOMEKLI label Table 1 >=1.50 m² band -> 4 mg capsule BID. 2 mg/m² x 1.85 m² = 3.7 mg theoretical; label discretizes to 4 mg. Reporting 4 mg per label banded-dose convention. Cmax in label Table 6 is steady-state at 2 mg/m² BID in adult patients; accumulation ratio 1.1-1.9 implies single-dose Cmax would be ~100-170 ng/mL. Reporting ss-Cmax per label primary source (spec A1 evaluates observed at clinical regimen).

source.citation: SpringWorks Therapeutics Inc. GOMEKLI (mirdametinib) capsules and tablets for oral suspension -- FDA prescribing information, Initial U.S. Approval 2025 (issued Feb 2025, revised Nov 2025). NDA 219379/219389. DailyMed SPL v5 setid 4c41bf90-5fa7-4935-a95c-e047ea6bbf8e.
source.table_ref: Section 12.3 Pharmacokinetics, Table 6 -- steady-state Cmax [mean (%CV)] 188 (52%) ng/mL in adult patients (>=18y); Tmax capsule median 1.1 h (range 0-4); terminal t1/2 28 h (12% CV). Adult N=58 from ReNeu Phase 2b (NCT03962543) Section 14.1 Table 7. Verified verbatim via DailyMed WebFetch 2026-04-23, which also confirmed: 'Mirdametinib is a substrate of BCRP and P-gp transporters' and 'Metabolism involves glucuronidation and oxidation via UGT (primarily UGT1A6 and UGT2B7) and CES enzymes.'

mirdametinib.notes: FDA NME approved 11 Feb 2025 for adult and pediatric (>=2y) NF1-associated plexiform neurofibromas. Mirdametinib (PD-0325901) is an allosteric MEK1/2 inhibitor. Cmax is steady-state (not single-dose); single-dose equivalent via accumulation ratio 1.1-1.9 would be ~100-170 ng/mL. Reporting ss per label convention; engine must handle steady-state or use single-dose approximation. Patient cohort (not HV) noted. Label explicitly states NOT an OATP1B1 substrate (only BCRP + P-gp), confirmed via DailyMed. Glucuronidation-dominant metabolism (UGT1A6 + UGT2B7) + CES contribution is a rare enzyme combination in the N50 and tests UGT coverage. SD from CV: 188 x 0.52 = 97.8 ng/mL = 0.0978 mg/L. SMILES + CID + formula + MW cross-validated against PubChem (InChIKey match with R-stereochemistry). URL verified 2026-04-23 (HTTP 200). Exclusion grep clean.
